control.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects, menu items, segments

inset.$description: Notices, segmented controls, menus and containers nested in a card

chrome.$description: Navigation bars and large hero media

narrow.$description: Below this: small phones; stack side-by-side pairs

expanded.$description: medium < 840 ≤ expanded: sidebar replaces the bottom bar

pageGutter.$description: Page side gutter per window class

minimum.$description: Touch target on every platform; a small icon never means a small target

bottomBarMinHeight.$description: Bottom bar height before safe-area inset

minHeight.$description: Minimum monthly plan status control height

maxWidth.$description: Monthly plan status maximum reading width

width.$description: One ring on every focusable element; 3:1 against every surface it lands on

insetOffset.$description: Ring drawn inside items clipped by their container (bottom bar, list options)

sm.$description: Icon inside a button or row

md.$description: Icon tile in a list row

fa.$value: Vazirmatn, Tahoma, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

mono.$description: Machine identifiers and diagnostic values only

digits.$description: Vazirmatn limited to digits, percent and separators by unicode-range; prefixed to every stack so numbers always render in Vazirmatn

display.$description: Landing hero only; marketing pages may scale it fluidly with clamp() — FA

title1.$description: Page title, once per page — FA

headline.$description: Card titles and emphasised rows — FA

footnote.$description: Field labels, legend rows, secondary lines — FA

caption.$description: Smallest text: pills, hints, timestamps. Nothing smaller exists — FA

subtle.$description: Grouped background below opaque content surfaces

glassInteractionEnergy.$description: Brief localized coral interaction highlight; never a persistent primary-action fill

glassFallback.$description: Opaque fallback for every glass material when transparency is unavailable or reduced

hover.$description: Pointer hover fill for secondary, ghost and row controls

glassLowlight.$description: Bottom inner shade of Liquid Glass

glassCore.$description: Core fill of Liquid Glass materials

glassFrost.$description: Denser glass (60%) for menus and popovers that open over text, so their own labels stay legible.
